svg.title: Still Thinking — Chin Rest
svg.desc: An unresolved 10.8-second acting loop. Rocky rests a compact hand beneath the chin, looks up before leaning into a thought, makes a tiny chin adjustment, blinks and considers the other side, narrows one eye in doubt, looks briefly down, then returns to the same questioning upward gaze. Uneven holds, delayed body follow-through and quiet breathing. No answer, smile, celebration or resolved ending.
